ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that uses Moss to instantly classify incoming user utterances and dispatch them to specialized sub-agents without vector database latency overhead.
ideas.title: MossRouter: Sub-10ms Semantic Intent Router for Multi-Agent Systems
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly showcases Moss's core value proposition of sub-10ms semantic search, which judges are specifically looking for in this zero-latency sprint.

ideas.pitch: An edge-deployable voice agent middleware that uses Moss to instantly retrieve conversation history and facts within 10ms, allowing seamless human interruptions without awkward silence.
ideas.title: VoiceGaurd: Real-Time Interruption & Context Injection for Voice Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the real-time voice and low-latency agent focus mentioned prominently in the hackathon brief, making the product feel magically fast.

ideas.pitch: A local coding assistant extension that leverages Moss to perform instant semantic codebase search in the browser or on-device, providing zero-latency snippet retrieval for real-time code completion.
ideas.title: InstantDoc: Sub-10ms Context Injection for Local IDE Copilots
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a developer pain point by eliminating the massive retrieval lag typical in standard RAG-based IDE extensions.

ideas.pitch: An inline proxy that uses Moss to compare outgoing AI agent tool calls against a database of safety exemplars in under 10ms, blocking dangerous actions before execution.
ideas.title: MossGuard: Real-Time Hallucination & Policy Gate for AI Actions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard systems engineering with rigorous safety checks, matching the pattern of winning entries that solve complex runtime constraints.

ideas.pitch: An inference-time compute optimizer that uses Moss to instantly select the top 3 most relevant few-shot examples for an LLM prompt within 10ms, maximizing output quality while minimizing token waste.
ideas.title: FlashRecall: Zero-Latency Dynamic Few-Shot Exemplar Selector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies Moss's ultra-fast retrieval to the cutting-edge domain of inference-time compute and efficient prompt optimization.
